CUR=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) || CUR=""
echo "BASE=$BASE CUR=$CUR"

COMMON_DIR=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) || COMMON_DIR=""
GIT_DIR_PATH=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || GIT_DIR_PATH=""
echo "COMMON_DIR=$COMMON_DIR"
echo "GIT_DIR_PA …[per-command-truncated]

\

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/workpad.py update 1863 --note "issue-claim audit (count): claimed 'three light commands' (/prflow:review, /prflow:review-and-fix, /prflow:pr-description), verified matching allowlist at scripts/resolve-command-trigger.sh:156 at HEAD" && \
.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts …[per-command-truncated]

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)

  echo "::warning::phase-3.3: could not create $ROOT/.prflow/tmp" >&2
fi
[ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ] && setopt nonomatch || :
set -- "$ROOT"/.prflow/tmp/review/*/*/iter-*.json
if [ -e "$1" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$@" | sort; fi
echo "SNAPSHOT-DONE"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1874/32421739289-1/verdicts/iter-1
cat > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1874/32421739289-1/verdicts/iter-1/VC-6-w4x7.json << 'EOF'
{"id":"VC-6","verdict":"PASS","evidence":"git diff --merge-base origin/main -- .github/workflows/devflow.yml shows four hunks, all touching only comment lines beginning with '#'. The executable lines (TARGET_NUMBER=\"${COMMAND##* }\", PR_NUMBER=\"${COMMAND##* }\", and the case ''|*[!0-9]*) TARGET_NUMBER=\"$CONTEXT_NUMBER\" ;; glob) are byte-iden …[per-command-truncated]

awk 'NR<=2082 && /^      - name:/{n=$0} END{}' .github/workflows/devflow.yml
for ln in 2082 2189 2320; do
  echo "== line $ln =="; awk -v L=$ln 'NR<=L && /^      - name:/{n=$0} NR==L{print n}' .github/workflows/devflow.yml
done

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/verification-flights
FP=$(python3 .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py)
cat > /tmp/flight-input.json <<EOF
{"command": "lib/test/run-module.sh review-trigger-helpers", "checkout_fingerprint": $FP}
EOF

python3 .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/verification-flight.py claim --input-file /tmp/flight-input.json --state-dir .prflow/tmp/verification-flights 2>&1

python3 - <<'PYEOF'

fp = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["python3", ".prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py"]))
data = {"command": "lib/test/run-module.sh review-trigger-helpers", "checkout_fingerprint": fp}
with open("/tmp/flight-input.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(data, f)
print(json.dumps(data))
PYEOF

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; git checkout issue-1863-ignore-the-trailing-number-on-comment-triggered >/dev/null 2>&1 && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; echo "=== growth ==="; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/prompt-surface-growth.py 2>&1 || scripts/prompt-surface-growth.py 2>&1

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; N=$(gh pr view 1874 --json number --jq '.number'); if [ -z "$N" ]; then echo "EMPTY PR NUMBER"; exit 1; fi; gh api --method PATCH "repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/$N" -F body=@.prflow/tmp/pr-1874-body.md --jq '.number' && echo "patched $N"

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/run-jq.sh -r '.comment.id // empty' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "---fallback---"
gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1863/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true
